department: School of Computer Science, Ph.D. in Computer Science

deadline.value: Final graduate deadline is December 9, 2026; the early deadline of November 18 gives a lower fee.

app_fee.value: The SCS application fee is $100 per program, or $80 before the early deadline.
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $100 per program.

fee_waiver.value: A fee waiver is available only for financial hardship, within the application.
fee_waiver.quote: you may apply for a financial or participants of program fee waiver, which is available within the application

gre_general.value: Each program sets its own GRE policy; the CS PhD page could not be fetched.
gre_general.quote: Each program sets its policy on whether Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are required

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: No minimum is stated; the page gives only the score ranges admitted applicants usually submit.
toefl_min.quote: In the past few years, most of our admitted applicants submitted total test scores in the ranges below

ielts_min.value: No minimum is stated; the page gives only the score ranges admitted applicants usually submit.
ielts_min.quote: In the past few years, most of our admitted applicants submitted total test scores in the ranges below

english_waiver.value: No waiver for non-native speakers, even after US or English-language study; MOI certificates are not accepted.
english_waiver.quote: We do not issue waivers for non-native speakers of English.

also.quote: Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificates are not accepted as a substitute for an English proficiency test.

supervisor.value: Students are matched with an adviser after admission, based on mutual research interests.
supervisor.quote: you’ll be matched with an adviser based primarily on mutual research interests and begin a research project on day one

funding.value: All PhD students get full financial support while in good academic standing.
funding.quote: All of our Ph.D. students receive full financial support while in good academic standing

entry_route.value: The pages reached do not say whether a bachelor's or master's is required.
